blocks.text: Admins can create tags for custom namespaces in Microsegmentation that can then be assigned to resource groups. Cloud or machine learning (ML) tags are autogenerated from your organization's data, and you cannot manually configure them. You can edit or delete custom tags at any time.
Enable policy enforcement for your organization. To learn more, see Enabling Microsegmentation Policy Settings.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Cloud > Microsegmentation > Tag Management.
Select the namespace in which you want to add a tag.
Key: Enter a key name for the custom tag.
Description: (Optional) Add information to describe the tag.

Values: Add individual values, separated by commas, for the tag. To add many values to the tag, click the Add button next to the Values field, and it displays a table of all the added values. You can also delete any added values by clicking the Delete icon.

blocks.text: Your new custom tag appears in the list.
